description: List Stocktwits editorial market news (stocktwits.com/news-articles) via the site's own load-more JSON API. The default tab=stocktwits returns an array of the latest staff-written articles WITH FULL TEXT (content is a 3-6KB HTML body), plus headline, summary, related symbols (symbolCodes + symbolsMetadata), tags, source, author profile, and created/updated timestamps — one request, no detail page needed. tab selects the feed: stocktwits (default, array w/ full content) | trending | stocks (both symbol-grouped objects, summary-only) | crypto (array, summary-only) | watchlist (empty when anonymous, needs login). limit 1-50 (default 10, verified 50 in one call). after_sid is the pagination cursor = the previous page's last article sid. partial=true when fewer than limit were returned (end of feed). No login or browser required.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: News tab enum. stocktwits (default — 编辑团队新闻，数组带全文 content 3-6KB) | trending（按 symbol 分组的对象 {symbol:[articles]}，摘要-only，content 为空字符串） | stocks（按 symbol 分组的对象，摘要-only，content 为空字符串） | crypto（数组，摘要-only，content 为空字符串，平台真实行为） | watchlist（匿名返回空数组，需登录）。对应站点 news-articles 页各 tab。

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max articles to return, integer 1-50, default 10. Verified that limit=50 returns 50 in a single request. 返回条数上限，默认 10，最大 50。

parameters.name: after_sid
parameters.description: Pagination cursor: the sid of the last article of the previous page; pass it to fetch the next page of older articles (maps to the API's lastArticleSid param). Optional. 分页游标：上一页末篇的 sid，传入即取下一页更早的文章；可选。
